title: 混合开放式三进化框架打造更优深度研究者
summary: 提出混合开放式三进化（HOTE）框架，通过混合模式强化学习促进提议者、求解者和评判者的协同进化，以弥合深度研究与智能体进化之间的差距。在8B模型上超越静态开源8-32B模型及最先进训练方法，验证了三模块进化不可或缺。
summary_en: Proposes the Hybrid Open-Ended Tri-Evolution (HOTE) framework, which uses hybrid-mode reinforcement learning to facilitate the collaborative evolution of a proposer, solver, and judge, bridging deep research and agent evolution. An 8B model surpasses static open 8-32B models and state-of-the-art training methods, confirming the indispensability of all three modules.
